performance_report.title: Q4 2025 Global Performance Report
performance_report.content: Revenue grew by 12% YoY reaching $15.4B. Operating margin improved to 24%. However, supply chain disruptions in Southeast Asia led to a 5% increase in logistics costs. Cloud services saw a 30% surge in adoption, while hardware sales remained flat. Key risks include fluctuating exchange rates and semiconductor shortages.

hr_policy.title: Remote Work Policy v2.1
hr_policy.content: Employees are allowed to work from home. Equipment will be provided upon request. Performance will be measured by output. Managers must approve all schedules. All employees must be online during core hours.
